gizmo.title: Mutambo wekutsvaga pfungwa
gizmo.description: Nyika yekufamba-famba. Pfungwa dzinokutsvaga ndokukubvunza mubvunzo. Pindura zvakanaka kuti ukunde imwe uye uvhure imba yayo. Chidimbu chinoratidza kuyedza nezvekuongorora.

configure.title: Kutsvaga
configure.description: Prompt inoratidzwa pascreen yekutanga. Udza mutambi kuti rwendo urwu rwekudiniko.

configure.title: Pfungwa
configure.description: Pfungwa imwe neimwe imba ine chikara.

configure.title: Zita riri pakati
configure.description: Pfungwa inoumbwa nepfungwa dzese pamwe chete.

configure.title: Mushure memutambo
configure.description: Hazvisi zvekumanikidzwa. Inotsiva bhokisi rekukopa prompt pachikamu chekupedzisa nezvinyorwa zvako, senhanho inotevera kana link.

configure.title: Mabhatani akawedzerwa mushure memutambo
configure.description: Hazvisi zvekumanikidzwa. Mabhatani kana malink anoratidzwa padhuze neTambazve pachikamu chekupedzisa.

advanced.title: Moyo
advanced.description: Mhinduro dzisiri dzechokwadi pfungwa isati yatiza.

advanced.title: Mbeu yemunhu
advanced.description: Zvinyorwa zvipi zvazvo. Mbeu imwe chete inogadzira munhu mumwe chete nguva dzese. Iyi ndiyo mbeu inoshandiswa neHAX avatar.

advanced.title: Shandisa munhu wemunhu akapinda
advanced.description: Kana mumwe munhu akapinda muHAX, munhu uyu anotaridzika seavatar yake. Vamwe vese vanoona mbeu iri pamusoro.

advanced.title: Mutsetse uri pamusoro peprompt
advanced.description: Siya usina chinhu kuti uwane mutsetse wepakutanga.

advanced.title: Prompt yekukopa
advanced.description: Inoratidzwa pachikamu chekupedzisa nebhatani rekukopa. Idzima kuti ufukidze bhokisi.

advanced.title: Zita remutambo
advanced.description: Inopa mutambo uyu zita muzviitiko zvekufambira mberi uye pamarkup yeOER Schema.

advanced.title: Id yemutambo
advanced.description: Hazvisi zvekumanikidzwa. Inosiyanisa mutambo uyu nemimwe iri papeji muzviitiko zvekufambira mberi.
